stem.text: In the circuit below, P is a potentiometer of total resistance $10\,\Omega$ and Q is a fixed resistor of resistance $10\,\Omega$. The battery has an e.m.f. of $4.0\,\text{V}$ and negligible internal resistance. The voltmeter has a very high resistance.

stem.alt: Circuit: a 4.0 V battery feeds a potentiometer P, with ends X at the top and Y at the bottom, in series with a fixed resistor Q; a voltmeter V is connected between the slider on P and the bottom of the circuit

stem.text: The slider on the potentiometer is moved from X to Y and a graph of voltmeter reading $V$ is plotted against slider position.

A.alt: V against slider position from X to Y: straight line falling from 4 V at X to about 2 V at Y

B.alt: V against slider position from X to Y: straight line rising from 0 at X to 4 V at Y

C.alt: V against slider position from X to Y: straight line falling from 4 V at X to 0 at Y

D.alt: V against slider position from X to Y: straight line rising from 2 V at X to 4 V at Y
